title: The Pink Graduation Gown Costume
intro: The bunny suit gets the attention, but the graduation scene is the one people quote. A shiny pink cap and gown over blush satin strappy heels, gold pearl drop earrings, hot pink satin bows and a pink floral clutch reads instantly, it is office party safe and it goes on in five minutes over whatever you are already wearing. Carry the faux peonies for the photos and hand them to the best dressed person at the party. The heels and the clutch are wedding guest pieces for the rest of the year.

items.name: Pink shiny graduation cap and gown set
Blush satin pointed toe strappy heels
Hot pink satin hair bows, 2 pack
